description: "We are Vanguard Bio, an interdisciplinary team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Driven by curiosity and scientific rigor, we bridge the gap between biological sciences and space exploration to pioneer innovative solutions for humanity’s next frontier."
summary:
AEGIS: Next-Generation Extravehicular Bio-Telemetry & Spatial Rescue Ecosystem

Engineered by Team Vanguard Bio, AEGIS is a mission-critical astronaut health and situational awareness ecosystem designed for deep-space Extravehicular Activities (EVA) on planetary surfaces. At its core is an ESP32-powered smart bio-belt worn beneath the pressure suit, delivering real-time, non-invasive physiological monitoring—including PPG/PTT-based continuous blood pressure (CBP) estimation, SpO2, heart rate, and localized renal perfusion tracking.

Engineered for deep-space environments, AEGIS encrypts telemetry via military-grade AES-256 while seamlessly adapting to space network latency constraints.

The command dashboard features layered 3D suit rendering with an interactive anatomical view, a 360° tactical radar sweep matrix with Euclidean nearest-neighbor auto-dispatch for crew rescue operations, and a 60 FPS GPU-accelerated AR Visor HUD with dynamic parallax head-tracking. Complementing the visual interface is an integrated dual-channel open-ear bone conduction audio matrix, delivering spatialized voice telemetry directly through cranial structure. This ensures critical emergency cues are communicated clearly without compromising the astronaut's situational awareness during high-risk lunar or Martian operations.
details:
1. What the Project Does & How It Works

AEGIS (developed by Team Vanguard Bio) is an end-to-end astronaut health-monitoring and spatial safety architecture engineered for deep-space Extravehicular Activities (EVA) on Lunar and Martian surfaces.

  • Smart Bio-Belt & Telemetry: Worn directly against the skin beneath the pressure suit, an ESP32-based smart belt captures vital biometrics via skin-contact sensors. It executes real-time tracking of continuous blood pressure (CBP) using non-invasive PPG/PTT algorithms, oxygen saturation ($\text{SpO}_2$), heart rate, and localized renal perfusion to monitor kidney health and hydration.

    2. Benefits & Intended Impact

    • Encrypted Telemetry & Latency Management: Data streams are secured using military-grade AES-256 encryption and transmitted via protocol layers designed to handle deep-space communication delays.
    • Interactive Mission Control Dashboard: Built with a GPU-accelerated web interface featuring dynamic 3D rendering of the spacesuit with an anatomical toggle layer, an active 360° rotating marine-style radar matrix, and an In-Helmet AR Visor HUD mode with 3D parallax head-tracking.
    • Autonomous Rescue Dispatch: Upon detecting critical physiological anomalies, the radar system executes a Euclidean nearest-neighbor algorithm across coordinate space, automatically identifying and routing the closest available crew member for buddy rescue.
    • Spatial Acoustic Cues: Critical alerts are delivered via dual-channel open-ear bone conduction transducers, utilizing spatialized stereo audio to notify astronauts without obstructing ambient environmental cues.
    • Uncompromised EVA Safety: Provides continuous, non-invasive vital sign monitoring inside pressurized space suits without relying on bulky or uncomfortable medical hardware.
    • Early Organ Stress Detection: Monitors renal perfusion and hydration trends in real time, preventing acute kidney injuries and dehydration during long-duration extravehicular missions.
    • Rapid Emergency Response: Replaces manual search operations with automated, distance-calculated crew routing, drastically reducing rescue response times during life-threatening surface emergencies.
    • Preserved Situational Awareness: The open-ear bone conduction audio matrix ensures high-priority voice and spatial telemetry alerts reach the crew through cranial sound transmission while leaving their outer ears open to ambient helmet sounds.
      • Microcontroller: ESP32 (Wi-Fi / BLE dual-core microarchitecture)
        • Audio Hardware: Dual-channel Bone Conduction Transducers (Stereo Open-Ear Audio)
